extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Map T: V -> W preserving addition and scalar multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set V equipped with addition and scalar multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Kernel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of vectors v in V such that T(v) = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Image
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of all outputs T(v) for v in V.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Kernel of a linear transformation or matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Column space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space spanned by the columns of a matrix; image of a linear map.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of the image or column space.

extracted_concepts.name: Nullity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of the kernel or null space.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-nullity theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dim(Ker T) + dim(Im T) = dim(V).

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A representing T relative to chosen bases.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Linearly independent spanning set for a vector space.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinates of a vector relative to a basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix P converting coordinates from one basis to another.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of expressing vectors or operators in a different basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A' = P^-1 A P representing the same transformation in another basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Composition of transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Applying one linear transformation after another.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product of matrices corresponding to composed transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Inner product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Symmetric, linear, positive definite pairing on a vector space.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard inner product in R^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vectors whose inner product is zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthonormal basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Basis whose vectors are mutually orthogonal and unit length.

extracted_concepts.name: Gram-Schmidt process
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Algorithm converting a basis into an orthonormal basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Least squares
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Best approximate solution to Ax = b.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Projection of a vector onto a subspace along an orthogonal direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Projection formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Proj_W v = sum_i <v, q_i> q_i for an orthonormal basis of W.

extracted_concepts.name: Angle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric notion defined using an inner product.

extracted_concepts.name: Positive definiteness
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: <v, v> >= 0 with equality only when v = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: <u, v> = <v, u> for an inner product.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inner product is linear in its arguments.

extracted_relations.evidence: Fix bases for V and W
converts any basis to an orthonormal basis
{q_i} is an orthonormal basis for W
